notes: Verifier I, wave 4 (batch I, I07). Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may search your library for a creature card with mana value 6 or greater, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.' Two creature cards qualify (mana value 6 and 7): you fire the may-offer, choose the Big Seven, and exactly ONE card (that one) goes to your hand; the Big Six stays in the library, which keeps 7 cards (8 minus the found card).
